technique_name: Write a script for a 30-second advertisement about a new product
description:
[FADE IN: A busy city street. A group of people are walking towards a store.]

[CUT TO: Inside the store. A man is scanning the shelves, picking up products and examining them.]


[SPEAKER: A vibrant female voice begins to narrate]

Introducing the new [PRODUCT NAME], the newest product to revolutionize the way you shop! [PRODUCT NAME] is an all-in-one solution that allows you to search for and compare prices on hundreds of thousands of products, helping you make informed purchasing decisions in
